newsitem.title: UK: Bournemouth football club goes into receivership.
newsitem.headline: Bournemouth football club goes into receivership.

text.p: English second division soocer club AFC Bournemouth went into receivership on Friday with debts of more than 3.7 million, club directors said.
Bournemouth's bankers Lloyds, who are owed 2.1 million pounds, called in the receivers after rejecting a rescue package organised by the club.
Privately-owned Bournemouth are hoping to carry on until the end of the season and only then will the receivers know if they will fold.
Bournemouth director Roy Pack, who was only appointed to the board on Monday, said: "This is an absolute disaster for the club and its creditors who now won't get paid."
Millwall, another second division club, called in administrators this week as they sought to put together a refinancing plan after plunging 10 million stg into debt.
